thread:
taylor: Hi finance - quick help. I tapped the company card into an Uber 'tap-to-pay' terminal today and the card feed shows UBER*TPAY 4421. Expense-bot didn't auto-match and the trip receipt in the Uber app lists a different merchant name. Need to submit but not sure which merchant to pick in Ramp. Screenshot attached.
max_finance: Can you attach the trip receipt (PDF or email) and the bank feed screenshot? Also confirm trip date/time and amount.
taylor: Attached both. Trip 2026-03-18 09:12, $32.50. Bank feed line: UBER*TPAY 4421. Email receipt shows "Uber BVBA" as merchant.
expense-bot: auto-match failed: multiple merchant candidates found ("UBER*LONDON", "UBER EMEA", "UBER BVBA"). Please confirm merchant or upload receipt.
jordan: For Ramp choose the closest merchant if available (e.g., "Uber (Ground Transport)"). If merchant options don't match, categorize as Travel: Ground and add a note about the bank/merchant name mismatch. Finance will accept with receipt + manager approval when needed.
taylor: Do I need manager approval for $32.50?
max_finance: No - expenses under $75 auto-approve when receipt is attached and category is Travel. This one triggered the mismatch flag, so include a one-line note: merchant mismatch: bank shows UBER*TPAY 4421; receipt shows Uber BVBA.
taylor: One more: the card feed has two lines - base fare and a separate tip line of $4.00. How should I split in Ramp?
jordan: Use Ramp's split feature. Put fare $28.50 to Travel: Ground, tip $4.00 to Tips & Gratuities (or Misc Travel Expense if no tip GL). Add memo 'in-app tip'.
max_finance: Confirming tip categorization is fine. I'll reconcile on our side. Mark the expense as private if any personal info is included in the screenshot.
taylor: Done - uploaded split amounts, added note, set to private, and submitted. Thanks! :thumbsup: 
expense-bot: Expense queued for reconciliation. Flag: merchant-name-mismatch. Auditor note attached.
